name: Fabulist Gem
entries: This glittering red gem is commonly found embedded in a ring or brooch. While wearing the gem, you gain the following benefits.

Counterfeit Coins. As an action, magically create a pile of coins worth no more than 100 gp in an unoccupied space within 10 feet of yourself. After 1 hour, the coins vanish. Once used, this property cannot be used again until the next dawn.
Illusory Fashion. As a bonus action, magically change the appearance of your clothing and armor. The change can alter style, color, and apparent quality, but it fails to pass physical inspection.
